Assistant A and Assistant B both provided the same correct implementation for finding the median of two sorted arrays with O(log(min(n, m))) time complexity and O(1) space complexity. However, Assistant B incorrectly claimed that the provided algorithm has a time complexity of O(n), which is not true.

In response to the second question, both assistants correctly explained that the O(log(min(n, m))) time complexity is already an efficient solution and close to the lower bound. However, Assistant B incorrectly stated that there is no algorithm with better time complexity than O(n) and mentioned the Median of Medians algorithm, which is not relevant to this problem.

Considering the correctness and helpfulness of the responses, Assistant A provided a better overall answer. Therefore, my final verdict is:

[[A]]
